task_completion.description: Agent successfully logged into the GeoServer admin interface.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The GeoServer web interface is visible with the 'admin' user logged in (usually shown in the top right corner) or the 'Welcome' page after login.

task_completion.description: A new style named 'river_buffer' is created.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Styles' page or 'Style Editor' showing the name field set to 'river_buffer'.

task_completion.description: The SLD code includes a transformation function for a buffer of 0.1 degrees.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The SLD editor showing XML code containing '<ogc:Function name="buffer">', '<ogc:PropertyName>the_geom</ogc:PropertyName>' (or similar geometry attribute), and the value '0.1'.

task_completion.description: The SLD code uses a PolygonSymbolizer with red fill (#FF0000) and 0.5 opacity.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The SLD editor showing '<CssParameter name="fill">#FF0000</CssParameter>' and '<CssParameter name="fill-opacity">0.5</CssParameter>' within a '<PolygonSymbolizer>' block.

task_completion.description: The 'river_buffer' style is assigned to the 'ne:ne_rivers' layer.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Layers' configuration page for 'ne_rivers' showing 'river_buffer' selected as the default style, or the 'Publishing' tab showing the association.

task_completion.description: The layer preview shows the rivers rendered with a thick red buffered area.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Layer Preview' for 'ne:ne_rivers' showing red, semi-transparent polygons following the river paths instead of simple thin lines.

integrity.description: The agent used the GeoServer web interface rather than just executing curl commands or direct file edits.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the browser navigating through the GeoServer web UI menus (Styles, Layers, Layer Editor).

integrity.description: The agent manually entered or edited the SLD rather than it appearing instantly without interaction.
integrity.visual_evidence: Sequential screenshots showing the SLD text area being populated or the 'Validate' button being clicked.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply create a text file claiming success.
integrity.visual_evidence: The final screenshots show the actual GeoServer application state, not just a terminal output.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The style must be named 'river_buffer'. The SLD must use a rendering transformation (ogc:Function name="buffer") with a distance of 0.1. The symbology must be a PolygonSymbolizer with fill #FF0000 and opacity 0.5. The target layer is 'ne:ne_rivers' in the 'ne' workspace. The coordinate system for this dataset is EPSG:4326 (degrees).
